recipe.title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado over Brown Rice
recipe.description: The real thing, lightened: seared strips of lean sirloin with blistered onion and tomato in a tangy soy-vinegar pan sauce, tumbled with air-fried potato wedges so they stay crisp instead of deep-fried, spooned over nutty brown rice.

ingredients.item: Beef sirloin, lean, cut in 1cm strips (new buy)
Baby gold potatoes, cut in wedges (new buy)
Onions, white, cut in thick wedges

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.content: Rinse 210 g brown rice and cook in the rice cooker with about 450 g water and a pinch of salt. It runs ~40 min on its own while you work.

steps.title: Air-fry the potato wedges
steps.content: Toss 450 g potato wedges with 10 g avocado oil, salt and pepper. Air fry at 200C/400F for 18-20 min, shaking halfway, until deep golden and crisp. Single layer — batch if crowded. Keep warm.

steps.title: Prep the sauce and season the beef
steps.content: Whisk 30 g soy sauce, 25 g red wine vinegar and the lime juice in a small bowl. Pat the beef strips very dry and season with 3 g cumin, salt and pepper. Pro tip: dry beef sears instead of steaming.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.content: Heat 10 g avocado oil in a large skillet or on the griddle over high (9-10). Sear the beef in two batches, ~1.5 min per side, just until browned. Don't crowd it. Remove to a plate.

steps.title: Blister the vegetables
steps.content: Add remaining 5 g oil to the hot pan. Add onion wedges and cook 2 min on high (9) to char the edges, then add tomato wedges and 15 g garlic, cook 1-2 min more until they just soften but hold shape.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.content: Return beef and any juices to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss 30-45 seconds on high just to coat and heat through — don't let the tomatoes collapse. Kill the heat, fold in the potato wedges, green onion and cilantro.

steps.title: Serve
steps.content: Spoon the rice onto plates and pile the lomo saltado over the top, scraping every drop of pan sauce out.

recipe.notes: Per serving (of 3): ~40g protein, ~575 cal, ~4.5g saturated fat, ~1g added sugar (none added — trace from ketchup-free sauce), ~7-8g fiber. New buys: sirloin, baby gold potatoes, brown rice, green onion, cilantro, low-sodium soy sauce, red wine vinegar, ground cumin. Storage: keeps 3 days; reheat on the Tovala Steam mode or in the skillet so the beef stays tender and potatoes don't go soggy in the microwave. Pro tips: high heat and a dry pan are everything here — sear in batches or you'll boil the beef; the acid goes in at the very end so it stays bright. Fatty liver: lean sirloin instead of fatty cut, potatoes air-fried in measured oil instead of deep-fried, brown rice for the whole grain, and low-sodium soy plus vinegar and lime carry the flavor without butter or sugar.
